units.title: Festivals and Celebrations

vocabulary.cn: 特别的事情(或仪式、庆典)

lines.text: Did you enjoy the festival this year?
lines.cn: 你今年享受这个节日了吗?

lines.text: Oh yes! The dragon dances were so exciting, and the lanterns were amazing.
lines.cn: 当然!舞龙太精彩了,灯笼也美极了。

lines.text: What did you like best about it?
lines.cn: 你最喜欢它的什么?

lines.text: Sitting with my family, admiring the shining moon and sharing mooncakes.
lines.cn: 和家人坐在一起,赏明月、分月饼。

units.grammarTitle: 现在分词(V-ing)作表语和定语

grammarQuiz.q:
______ if you study festivals carefully, you may be surprised to find that different cultures actually have a lot in common after all.

（被动语态 · 教材原句）

It is often ______ first sentence, gives the main idea. but sometimes it is found elsewhere in the paragraph. 4 In pairs, discuss the following questions. 1 What do most festivals seem to have in comm

Be sure to use ______ correct forms.

（被动语态 · 教材原句）

Today’s festivals have a ______ of origins, including the seasons of the year, famous , important events, and religions.

（被动语态 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: Festivals are celebrated all over the world for many different reasons. No matter how different they seem, almost all of them share the same spirit: bringing people together to enjoy joy, gratitude and love.
reading.passageCn: 全世界出于各种不同的原因庆祝节日。无论它们看起来多么不同,几乎所有节日都有同样的精神:把人们聚在一起,分享喜悦、感激与爱。

questions.q: Why are festivals celebrated, according to the passage?
What do almost all festivals share?
opts: A spirit of bringing people together.

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences about a festival you like. Say when and with whom you celebrate it, one activity you enjoy, and how you feel. Use at least one -ing form as an attribute or predicative.
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话介绍一个你喜欢的节日:何时、和谁一起庆祝,你喜欢的一项活动,以及你的感受。至少用一个现在分词(V-ing)作定语或表语。

quizQuestions.q: On New Year's Eve, children get lucky money in red ____.
Customs play a ____ role in almost every festival.
People light firecrackers to drive away the ____ spirits.
The harvest festival is held after the ____ have been gathered in.
The dragon dance at the festival was really ____.
We watched the ____ moon rise slowly over the village.
The families ____ the Lunar New Year enjoyed mooncakes together.
Look at the lanterns ____ slowly down the river.
听句子选中文:
opts: 每个节日都有自己独特的魅力。
quizQuestions.audio: Every festival has its own customs and unique charm.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 穿上传统服装的舞者沿街游行。
quizQuestions.audio: Dancers in traditional costumes marched along the streets.

listeningQuestions.audio: Families gather to admire the shining moon and enjoy mooncakes.
opts: 家人聚在一起赏明月、品月饼。
人们卖掉了所有的灯笼。

listeningQuestions.audio: These floating lanterns on the river are truly amazing.
opts: 河上漂浮的这些灯笼真是令人惊叹。

listeningQuestions.audio: Lighting firecrackers is a typical Spring Festival custom.
opts: 人们在春节安静地待在家里。
放鞭炮是春节的一个典型习俗。
鞭炮在夏天才会被点燃。

listeningQuestions.audio: People decorate churches and town halls with flowers and fruit.
opts: 人们用鲜花和水果装饰教堂和市政厅。

listeningQuestions.audio: Some old customs may slowly fade away over time.
opts: 一些旧习俗可能随时间渐渐消失。

listeningQuestions.audio: Festivals reflect people's wishes and attitudes towards life.
opts: 节日反映了人们的愿望和对生活的态度。

finalReading.passage: On her first Spring Festival in China, Emma felt a little lost among the noise and the bright red decorations. Her host family welcomed her warmly, taught her to make dumplings, and gave her lucky money in a red envelope. By the end of the night, watching the smiling faces around the table, she finally understood why this festival means so much to so many people.

questions.q: How did Emma feel at the start of the festival?
options: Slightly confused by all the noise and red decorations.
Completely bored and sleepy.
Angry with her host family.
Sure that she already knew everything.
questions.explanation: 原文 'felt a little lost among the noise and the bright red decorations' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What helped Emma understand the festival by the end of the night?
options: Reading a long history book alone.
Seeing the happy people gathered around the table.
Leaving the dinner early.
Counting her lucky money.
questions.explanation: 末句 'watching the smiling faces around the table, she finally understood' 的转述(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

dialogues.title: A Kind Act on the Bus

lines.text: You look happy today. What happened?
lines.cn: 你今天看起来很开心,发生什么事了?

lines.text: On the bus this morning, I saw a boy give his seat to an old man.
lines.cn: 今早在公交车上,我看到一个男孩把座位让给了一位老人。

lines.text: That's kind. Did the old man say anything?
lines.cn: 真善良。老人说什么了吗?

lines.text: Yes. Smiling warmly, he thanked the boy and called him a real gentleman.
lines.cn: 说了。老人温暖地微笑着,感谢男孩,称他是真正的绅士。

lines.text: Small acts like that really make the world kinder.
lines.cn: 正是这样的小举动让世界变得更友善。

lines.text: Exactly. Seeing it made me want to be kinder too.
lines.cn: 没错。看到这一幕,我也想变得更善良。

grammarQuiz.q:
______ days, festivals are becoming more , with people spending more money on gifts.

（情态动词与道德选择 · 教材原句）

Festivals ______’s wishes, beliefs, faiths, and attitudes towards life.

（情态动词与道德选择 · 教材原句）

They are to ______ time with family, and to relax and enjoy life.

（情态动词与道德选择 · 教材原句）

Discovering Useful Structures ______ festival activities 1 Read the sentences below and discuss the functions and meanings of the italicised -ing form.

（情态动词与道德选择 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: A virtue is rarely a grand act done once. As one poet wrote, the best part of a good person's life is made up of small, nameless acts of kindness that nobody even remembers. Helping a stranger, telling the truth, or simply being thankful can slowly make a whole society kinder.
reading.passageCn: 美德很少是只做一次的壮举。正如一位诗人所写,一个好人一生中最美好的部分,是由那些微小、无名、甚至无人记得的善举构成的。帮助陌生人、讲真话,或仅仅心怀感恩,都能慢慢让整个社会变得更友善。

questions.q: According to the poet, what makes up the best part of a good person's life?
What can slowly make a whole society kinder?
opts: Everyday acts like helping strangers and being thankful.

writing.prompt: Write a short story (about 60 words) praising a moral act you saw, using at least one present participle (V-ing) as an adverbial, such as 'Seeing the old man fall, …'.
writing.promptCn: 写一段约60词的小故事,赞扬你见到的一次善举,至少用一个现在分词(V-ing)作状语,例如 'Seeing the old man fall, …'。

quizQuestions.q: Honesty and courage are admired in every culture; they are true ____.
She faced a moral ____, where every choice was equally hard to make.
The kind doctor opened a private ____ to treat poor patients for low fees.
To a person, nothing is more ____ than their own life.
____ that his wife had been injured, Mr Johnson hurried to the hospital.
The child lay on her mother's lap, ____ sweetly to herself.
I saw her ____ something into his ear, clearly not wanting to be heard.
The flood hit the small town, ____ thousands of families homeless.
听录音,选出与你听到的句子意思相符的一项。
opts: 想到仍需帮助的人们,林大夫开了一家私人诊所。
quizQuestions.audio: Thinking of all the people still in need of help, Dr Lin opened a private clinic.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音,选出与你听到的句子意思相符的一项。
opts: 女孩用尽全力把石头推到了路边。
quizQuestions.audio: The girl pushed the stone aside with all her might.

listeningQuestions.audio: Hearing the news, the doctor rushed to the hospital at once.
opts: 听到这个消息,医生立刻赶往医院。

listeningQuestions.audio: She sat by the bed, smiling gently at the sick child.
opts: 她坐在床边,温柔地对生病的孩子微笑。

listeningQuestions.audio: Seeing the old man fall, the girl ran over to help him up.
opts: 看到老人摔倒,女孩跑过去扶他起来。

listeningQuestions.audio: Thinking of the poor patients, the kind doctor charged very low fees.
opts: 医生向穷人收很高的费用。
想到贫穷的病人,善良的医生只收很低的费用。

listeningQuestions.audio: I saw her whispering something kind into the old woman's ear.
opts: 我看见她在老妇人耳边低声说着善意的话。

listeningQuestions.audio: Passing the kindness on, the waitress smiled at her next guest.
opts: 女服务员对客人发脾气。
把善意传递下去,女服务员对下一位客人微笑。
女服务员收了很多小费。

finalReading.passage: When Ben missed the bus, an old woman shared her umbrella and walked him to the next stop in the rain. He never learned her name, but he promised himself to do the same for a stranger one day. Months later, seeing a lost child crying in a busy street, he remembered that kindness and stopped at once to help.

questions.q: What did the old woman do for Ben?
options: She let him under her umbrella and saw him safely along the way.
She gave him money for a new bus ticket.
She drove him all the way home.
She called his parents for him.
questions.explanation: 原文老妇人分享雨伞并送他到下一站的转述;其余选项文中未提。

questions.q: Why did Ben stop to help the lost child?
options: Because the child asked him for money.
Because the kindness he once received inspired him.
Because the child was his own brother.
Because a teacher told him to.
questions.explanation: 末句他记起当年那份善意而出手相助的转述(覆盖短文后半段)。

lines.text: I'm going to Guizhou next month. Any places you'd recommend?
lines.cn: 我下个月要去贵州,你有什么推荐的地方吗?

lines.text: Definitely the ethnic minority villages. The culture there is so diverse.
lines.cn: 一定要去少数民族村寨,那里的文化非常多元。

lines.text: That sounds great. What can I see there?
lines.cn: 听起来很棒。我在那儿能看到什么?

lines.text: Traditional dances, old houses, and people playing the lusheng.
lines.cn: 传统舞蹈、古老的房子,还有人演奏芦笙。

grammarQuiz.q:
______ the -ing form used as the attribute or the predicative.

（多元文化阅读表达 · 教材原句）

Discussion: ______ festival is the best?

（多元文化阅读表达 · 教材原句）

Today 9:05 am Rio ______!

（多元文化阅读表达 · 教材原句）

I spent a really fun ______ there with my friends.

（多元文化阅读表达 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: Chinatown in San Francisco is the oldest in America. Each year it welcomes more visitors than even the famous bridge. People come for the food, the shops, and a real taste of Chinese culture.
reading.passageCn: 旧金山的唐人街是美国最古老的。它每年接待的游客比那座著名的大桥还多。人们为美食、店铺和地道的中国文化而来。

questions.q: What is special about this Chinatown?
opts: It is the oldest in America.
It is the newest in America.

questions.q: Why do people come to Chinatown?
opts: For the food, shops, and Chinese culture.

writing.prompt: Write a short introduction (3–4 sentences) to a culturally diverse place you know.
writing.promptCn: 写一段简短介绍(3-4句),介绍一个你知道的文化多元的地方。

quizQuestions.q: Yunnan is home to many ____ minority groups.
Some immigrants opened shops to ____ a living.
I ____ a Cantonese restaurant for dinner.
He wanted to buy some hand-made ____ as gifts.
—Will you join the village tour? —I'd love ____.
When ____ in Rome, do as the Romans do.
—Have you heard of the Monkey King? —Yes, I ____.
Justin loves the villages, and ____ does Linlin.
听句子选中文:
opts: 美式食物常融合多种文化做出新东西。
quizQuestions.audio: American food often mixes many cultures to make something new.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 这件乐器有一千多年的历史。
quizQuestions.audio: This instrument has a history of more than a thousand years.

listeningQuestions.audio: San Francisco is a city with many diverse cultures.
opts: 旧金山是一座拥有多元文化的城市。
旧金山是一座很小的城市。

listeningQuestions.audio: Many Chinese immigrants settled in Chinatown.
opts: 许多华人移民在唐人街定居。
许多游客离开了唐人街。

listeningQuestions.audio: Guizhou is home to many ethnic minority groups.
opts: 贵州是许多少数民族群体的家园。

listeningQuestions.audio: The climate here is mild all year round.
Nachos are corn chips covered in cheese.
opts: 墨西哥玉米片是裹着奶酪的玉米片。

listeningQuestions.audio: Visitors can buy souvenirs in the old shops.
opts: 游客可以在老店里买纪念品。

finalReading.passage: When Maria first moved to a new city, she felt lost among so many different cultures. Instead of staying home, she tasted new food, learned a few local words, and made friends from many countries. A year later, the rich mix of people no longer worried her; it had become the thing she loved most about her new home.

questions.q: What did Maria do instead of staying home?
options: She explored the food, picked up the language, and got to know people.
She returned to her old city at once.
She refused to leave her room.
She avoided everyone around her.
questions.explanation: 原文 'tasted new food, learned a few local words, and made friends' 的转述;其余与原文相反。

questions.q: How did Maria feel about the city a year later?
options: Still lost and worried.
She loved its mix of cultures most of all.
Sorry that she had moved there.
Bored by everyone around her.
questions.explanation: 末句 'it had become the thing she loved most' 的转述(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: Space Exploration

lines.text: If you could travel into space, would you go?
lines.cn: 如果你能去太空旅行,你会去吗?

lines.text: Of course! I'd love to see the blue Earth turning below me.
lines.cn: 当然!我很想看到脚下转动的蓝色地球。

lines.text: But you'd have to train for years to become an astronaut.
lines.cn: 可你得训练好多年才能成为宇航员。

lines.text: I know, yet the chance to explore the universe would be worth it.
lines.cn: 我知道,但能探索宇宙的机会会让这一切都值得。

units.grammarTitle: 不定式(to do)作目的状语/后置定语(in order to · so as to)

grammarQuiz.q:
______ if you study festivals carefully, you may be surprised to find that different cultures actually have a lot in common after all.

（被动语态 · 教材原句）

It is often ______ first sentence, gives the main idea. but sometimes it is found elsewhere in the paragraph. 4 In pairs, discuss the following questions. 1 What do most festivals seem to have in comm

Be sure to use ______ correct forms.

（被动语态 · 教材原句）

Today’s festivals have a ______ of origins, including the seasons of the year, famous , important events, and religions.

（被动语态 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: Space is sometimes called the final frontier. For thousands of years people only looked up at the stars and wondered, but today rockets and satellites let us study the universe more closely than ever before. Each new mission, however small, brings us a little nearer to its secrets.
reading.passageCn: 太空有时被称为最后的边疆。几千年来人们只能仰望星空、心生好奇,而如今火箭和卫星让我们比以往任何时候都更近距离地研究宇宙。每一次新的任务,无论多小,都让我们离它的秘密更近一点。

questions.q: What is space sometimes called?
How do we study the universe today?
opts: By only looking up with our eyes.
We cannot study it at all.

questions.q: What does each new mission do?
opts: It brings us closer to space's secrets.

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences saying whether you think space exploration is worth the cost, and give one reason. Try to use a to-infinitive of purpose (such as 'to find' or 'so as to help').
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话说说你认为太空探索是否值得,并给出一条理由。试着用表目的的不定式(如 to find 或 so as to help)。

quizQuestions.q: The spacecraft will ____ Earth for several days before landing.
A weather ____ records data about the wind and the rain.
Because there is little ____ in space, astronauts float around.
Pictures of Earth made people see that our ____ are limited.
Scientists make vehicles ____ brave people into space.
Astronauts collect dirty water so as ____ it for later use.
Neil Armstrong was the first man ____ on the moon.
The captain told the crew ____ their seatbelts at once.
听句子选中文:
quizQuestions.audio: Yang Liwei orbited Earth in the Shenzhou 5 spacecraft in 2003.

quizQuestions.q: 听句子选中文:
opts: 用现有技术,去火星往返要两年多。
quizQuestions.audio: Using current technology, a trip to Mars and back would take over two years.

listeningQuestions.audio: Yuri Gagarin was the first person to go into space.
opts: 尤里·加加林是第一个进入太空的人。
他是第一个登上月球的人。

listeningQuestions.audio: Because there is little gravity, everything in the station floats.
opts: 由于重力很小,站内一切都会漂浮。

listeningQuestions.audio: Astronauts exercise every day so as to keep their muscles strong.
opts: 宇航员每天锻炼以保持肌肉强健。

listeningQuestions.audio: China sent Chang'e 4 to explore the far side of the moon.
opts: 中国派嫦娥四号去探索月球背面。

listeningQuestions.audio: Satellites collect data so as to help farmers grow more food.
opts: 卫星收集数据以帮助农民种出更多粮食。

listeningQuestions.audio: Scientists are determined to send people to Mars one day.
opts: 科学家已经放弃了火星。
科学家决心有朝一日把人送上火星。
火星离地球很近很安全。

finalReading.passage: When Sam was a boy, he kept a small model rocket on his desk and promised himself he would build a real one. He studied physics for years so as to understand how spacecraft escape Earth's pull. Today he helps design satellites, proud that a childhood dream led him to a job among the stars.

questions.q: Why did Sam study physics for so many years?
options: To learn how spacecraft break free from Earth's gravity.
To become a famous singer.
To buy a bigger model rocket.
To forget his childhood dream.
questions.explanation: 原文 'so as to understand how spacecraft escape Earth's pull' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: How does Sam feel about his work today?
options: Bored and tired of space.
Proud that his early dream led to this job.
Sorry that he ever started.
Worried that he chose the wrong career.
questions.explanation: 末句 'proud that a childhood dream led him to a job among the stars'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。

units.title: The Value of Money

lines.text: What do you usually do with your pocket money?
lines.cn: 你通常怎么花零花钱?

lines.text: I divide it into three parts: one to spend, one to save, and one to give away.
lines.cn: 我把它分成三份:一份花、一份存、一份捐出去。

lines.text: That's wise. I always spend mine too quickly.
lines.cn: 真明智。我总是花得太快了。

lines.text: You should try saving a little each week. Money is a good servant, not a master!
lines.cn: 你应该试着每周存一点。金钱是好仆人,可不是主人!

units.grammarTitle: 情态动词(modal verbs)+ would 表过去将来

grammarQuiz.q:
______ if you study festivals carefully, you may be surprised to find that different cultures actually have a lot in common after all.

（被动语态 · 教材原句）

It is often ______ first sentence, gives the main idea. but sometimes it is found elsewhere in the paragraph. 4 In pairs, discuss the following questions. 1 What do most festivals seem to have in comm

Be sure to use ______ correct forms.

（被动语态 · 教材原句）

Today’s festivals have a ______ of origins, including the seasons of the year, famous , important events, and religions.

（被动语态 · 教材原句）

reading.passage: When Henry showed the great bank note in the tailor's shop, the rude clerks suddenly became polite. They brought out their finest suits and said he could pay whenever he liked. The story shows how quickly people change once they think a stranger is rich.
reading.passageCn: 当亨利在裁缝店里掏出那张巨额钞票时,原本粗鲁的店员们一下子变得彬彬有礼。他们拿出最好的西装,说他什么时候付款都行。这个故事说明,一旦人们认为陌生人很有钱,态度就会变得多么快。

questions.q: Why did the clerks suddenly become polite?
opts: They thought Henry was rich after seeing the note.
The shop was about to close.

questions.q: What does the story mainly show?
opts: How fast people change once they think someone is rich.
How to make a good suit.
Why notes are printed on paper.

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences about how you manage your pocket money and your attitude to money.
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话写一写你如何管理自己的零花钱,以及你对金钱的看法。

quizQuestions.q: She had spent all her savings and taken out a large ____.
We should not ____ people by their external appearance.
The first clerk spoke to Henry in a rude ____.
Henry had no money and ____ to stay in the city.
He has worked hard for years, so he ____ be completely poor.
The light is still on, so someone ____ still be in the office.
It's getting late, so you ____ to be on your way home now.
When she was young, my grandmother ____ sit by the window for hours.
听录音,选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 说实话,我现在身无分文。
quizQuestions.audio: To be honest, I have no money at all right now.

quizQuestions.q: 听录音,选出正确的中文意思。
opts: 买东西前先等一天,问问自己是否真的需要它。
看到喜欢的就立刻买下来。
quizQuestions.audio: Before you buy something, wait one day and ask if you really need it.

listeningQuestions.audio: Money is a good servant and a bad master.
opts: 金钱是好仆人,也是坏主人。

listeningQuestions.audio: You shouldn't judge people by the clothes they wear.
opts: 你不应以衣着来评判别人。
你应该多买几件新衣服。
穿好衣服的人更值得信任。
衣服决定一个人的价值。

listeningQuestions.audio: She found the lost money and returned it, expecting nothing in return.
opts: 她捡到丢失的钱并归还,不求任何回报。
她捡到钱后自己留下了。

listeningQuestions.audio: We ought to save part of our pocket money every week.
opts: 我们应当每周把一部分零花钱存起来。
我们应当一拿到钱就花光。

listeningQuestions.audio: He had to take out a large loan to pay for his daughter's care.
opts: 他不得不贷一大笔款来支付女儿的治疗费。
他把钱都捐给了慈善机构。
他从银行取走了所有积蓄。

listeningQuestions.audio: A wise person keeps money useful, but never the most important thing.
opts: 明智的人让金钱有用,却绝不让它成为最重要的东西。
明智的人把金钱看得高于一切。
明智的人从不使用金钱。
明智的人喜欢把钱藏起来。

finalReading.passage: Ben used to spend every coin of his pocket money the moment he got it, and by the next day he had nothing left. After his teacher explained how to save a little each week, he began to put part of his money aside. Three months later, he had saved enough to buy the bicycle he had always wanted, and he felt proud of his own patience.

questions.q: What did Ben do with his pocket money at first?
options: He spent it all at once and soon had nothing.
He gave it to his teacher to keep.
He saved every coin in a bank.
He lent it to his classmates.
questions.explanation: 原文 'spend every coin… the moment he got it, and by the next day he had nothing left' 的转述。

questions.q: How did Ben feel after three months of saving?
options: Sorry that he had started saving.
Proud that his patience had paid off.
Bored with his new bicycle.
Angry at his teacher's advice.
questions.explanation: 末句 'felt proud of his own patience'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置);其余与原文相反或未提。
